input: Research 529 college savings plans for kids

gold.taskTitle: Research 529 college savings plans for kids
gold.taskDescription: Gather and evaluate information about 529 college savings plans to make an informed decision for saving for a child's education.

questions.title: How many children are you opening a 529 for?
questions.description: Understand how many beneficiaries are involved to determine if multiple accounts or strategies are needed.

questions.title: What are the ages of the children involved?
questions.description: Knowing the children's ages helps assess the investment timeline and urgency of opening an account.

questions.title: Which state do you currently live in?
questions.description: State residency determines eligibility for state tax deductions and whether an in-state or out-of-state plan is more advantageous.

questions.title: Do you have a monthly contribution amount in mind?
questions.description: Knowing the intended contribution amount helps evaluate which plan's minimums, fees, and investment options are the best fit.

questions.title: Are you the parent, grandparent, or another relation?
questions.description: The account owner's relationship to the beneficiary can affect financial aid calculations and contribution rules.

questions.title: Is a 4-year university the assumed education goal?
questions.description: Understanding the target type of institution — university, community college, or trade school — shapes which plan features matter most.

questions.title: Have you already looked at any specific 529 plans?
questions.description: Knowing if the user has a starting point or prior research helps avoid redundancy and focus on gaps in their knowledge.
